dxAqel"><h2>Integrity and Authenticity</h2><div class="wp-post-last-updated"><p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0px 0px 16px;">Released April 17, 2024</p><p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0px 0px 16px;">Effective May 17, 2024</p></div><div id="2024-H1-integrity-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><p>We want you to feel confident that you can access information that is reliable, discover content that is original, and engage with people who are authentic. This is foundational to building a community of trust and accountability both on and off-platform.</p></div><h3 id="1">Misinformation</h3><div id="2024-H1-integrity-subpost1-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><p>In a global community, it is natural for people to have different opinions, but we seek to operate on a shared set of facts and reality. <strong>We do not allow misinformation that may cause significant harm to individuals or society, regardless of intent.</strong> We rely on <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/safety/safety-partners/?lang=en" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">independent fact-checking partners</a>, guidance from public health authorities, and our database of previously fact-checked claims to help assess the accuracy of content.</p><p>Content is ineligible for the FYF if it contains misinformation that may cause moderate harm, such as certain health content, conspiracy theories, repurposed media, or misrepresented authoritative sources. To be cautious, unverified information about emergencies and content temporarily under review by fact-checkers is also ineligible for the FYF.</p><p>To help you manage your TikTok experience, we may apply warning labels to content that has been assessed by our fact-checking partners and cannot be verified as accurate. We may also send <a href="https://newsroom.tiktok.com/en-us/new-prompts-to-help-people-consider-before-they-share" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">prompts</a> to reconsider sharing such content.</p></div><div class="sc-dNLxif hpqYSP"><div class="sc-jqCOkK jIvPXx no-border"><div class="sc-uJMKN grexwc"><svg fill="currentColor" siteSlug="community-guidelines" padding-top: 0px;"><p><strong>Misinformation</strong> means false or misleading content.</p><p><strong>Significant harm</strong> means severe forms of physical harm (including life-threatening injury or death), psychological harm (including trauma), large-scale property damage, and societal harm (including undermining fundamental social processes or institutions).</p><p><strong>Moderate harm health misinformation </strong>means false or misleading content regarding the treatment or prevention of injuries, conditions, or illnesses that are <u>not</u> immediate or life-threatening.</p><p><strong>Conspiracy theories</strong> means beliefs about unexplained events, or involve rejecting generally accepted explanations for events, including suggesting they were carried out by covert or powerful individuals or groups.</p><p><strong>Repurposed media</strong> means unedited media content that is presented out of context and may mislead a person about a information that is recognized and trusted, such as reports from research institutions.</p><div id="2024-H1-integrity-subpost1-toggle1-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><div class="sc-tilXH id="2024-H1-integrity-subpost2-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><p>Elections are important events and are often the subject of intense discussion and analysis. We try to balance enabling these discussions, while also being a place that brings people together and does not cause division. <strong>We do not allow <a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/using-tiktok/growing-your-audience/government-politician-and-political-party-accounts" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">paid political promotion</a>, political advertising, or fundraising by politicians and political parties (for themselves or others).</strong> Our <a href="https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/tiktok-ads-policy-politics-religion-and-culture/?lang=en" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">political advertising policy</a> includes both traditional paid advertisements and creators receiving compensation to support or oppose a candidate for office.</p><p>We want to enable the informed exchange of civic ideas in a way that fosters productive dialogue. <strong>We do not allow misinformation or content about civic and electoral processes that may result in voter interference, disrupt the peaceful transfer of power, or lead to off-platform violence.</strong></p><p>Content may be ineligible for the FYF if it contains misinformation that can hinder the ability of a voter to make an informed decision. To be cautious, unverified claims about an election and content temporarily under review by fact-checkers may also be ineligible for the FYF.</p><p>To help you manage your TikTok experience, we may apply warning labels to content that has been assessed by our fact-checking partners and cannot be verified as accurate. Learn more about our <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/transparency/protecting-elections/?lang=en" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">election integrity</a> work, and <a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/using-tiktok/growing-your-audience/government-politician-and-political-party-accounts" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">Government, Politician and Political Party accounts</a>.</p></div><div class="sc-dNLxif hpqYSP"><div class="sc-jqCOkK jIvPXx no-border"><div class="sc-uJMKN grexwc"><svg fill="currentColor" class="sc-cIShpX bWEvDE"><h3 id="3">Edited Media and AI-Generated Content (AIGC)</h3><div id="2024-H1-integrity-subpost3-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><p>We welcome the creativity that new artificial intelligence (AI) and other digital technologies may unlock. However, AI and other digital editing technologies can make it difficult to tell the difference between fact and fiction, which may mislead individuals or harm society.<strong> We require you to label AIGC or edited media that shows realistic-appearing scenes or people. </strong>This can be done using the <a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/using-tiktok/creating-videos/ai-generated-content" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">AIGC label</a>, or by adding a clear caption, watermark, or sticker of your own.</p><p>Even when appropriately labeled, AIGC or edited media may still be harmful. <strong>We do not allow content that shares or shows fake authoritative sources or crisis events, or falsely shows public figures in certain contexts. </strong>This includes being bullied, making an endorsement, or being endorsed.</p><p>We are committed to protecting people's privacy. <strong>We do not allow content that contains the likeness of young people, or the likeness of adult private figures used without their permission.</strong></p></div><div class="sc-dNLxif hpqYSP"><div class="sc-jqCOkK jIvPXx no-border"><div class="sc-uJMKN grexwc"><svg fill="currentColor" siteSlug="community-guidelines" class="sc-jnlKLf kcMArV" viewBox="0 0 48 48" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em"><path d="m24 28.75 13.67-13.67a1 1 0 0 1 1.41 0l1.84 1.84a1 1 0 0 1 0 1.41L24.71 34.54a1 1 0 0 1-1.42 0L7.1 18.34a1 1 0 0 1 0-1.42l1.83-1.84a1 1 0 0 1 1.41 0L24 28.75Z"></path></svg><div class="sc-bbmXgH BhRni"><p>More information</p></div></div><div class="sc-gGBfsJ hgbacM" style="height: 0px; padding-top: 0px;"><p><strong>AI-generated content (AIGC) </strong>is content, including images, video, or audio, that is created or modified by artificial intelligence (AI) technology or machine-learning processes. This content may include images of real people, and may show highly realistic-appearing scenes or use a particular artistic style, such as a painting, cartoons, or anime.</p><p><strong>Significantly edited content</strong> is content that shows people doing something they did not do, saying something they did not say, or altering their appearance in a way that makes them difficult to recognize or identify. This includes applying certain face filters, or an animation of an individual.</p><p><strong>Misleading AIGC or edited media </strong>is audio or visual content that has been edited, including by combining different clips together, to change the composition, sequencing, or timing in a way that alters the meaning of the content and could mislead viewers about the truth of real world events.</p><p><strong>Realistic-appearing scenes or people</strong> is content that uses<strong> </strong>are scenes, using images, video, or audio, that would lead someone to believe that the person shown is real or the event took place in the real world, such as a scene that is shown in the style or quality of a photograph or video.</p><p><strong>Likeness</strong> is a clear representation of an individual. It includes audio and visual representation, and may show their face, body, or their distinctive appearance, gestures, or mannerisms.</p><p><strong>Public figures </strong>are adults (18 years and older) with a significant public role, such as a government official, politician, business leader, or celebrity. We do <u>not</u> identify people under the age of 18 as public figures.</p><p><strong>Private figures </strong>are all people under the age of 18, and adults (18 years and older) who are not public figures.</p><div id="2024-H1-integrity-subpost3-toggle1-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><div class="sc-tilXH liITGI"><span class="sc-hEsumM cfiPAH icon" style="position: relative;"><picture><source dxAqel"><h2>Regulated Goods and Commercial Activities</h2><div class="wp-post-last-updated"><p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0px 0px 16px;">Released April 17, 2024</p><p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0px 0px 16px;">Effective May 17, 2024</p></div><div id="2024-H1-regulated-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><p>TikTok is a place where you may share or search for information about regulated goods or commercial activities. To ensure we provide a space for you to learn without undue risk of physical or financial harm, we moderate content that involves goods or activities that may be risky, addictive, dangerous, fraudulent, or otherwise require a higher degree of care. For certain goods and services (such as gambling and alcohol), we make limited exceptions for paid advertisements by advertisers with TikTok's explicit permission, if they are in compliance with all relevant age-targeting restrictions, laws, and regulations <em>(learn more about our <a href="https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/advertising-on-tiktok-first-things-to-note?lang=en" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">advertisement policy</a>)</em>.</p></div><h3 id="1">Gambling</h3><div id="2024-H1-regulated-subpost1-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><p>Many people around the world find entertainment through games of chance. We recognize that risking money in a game or on a bet may lead to potential harm for some people, including serious financial loss or mental health problems. <strong>We do not allow the facilitation or marketing of gambling or gambling-like activities.</strong></p><p>We also recognize that gambling can put young people at a heightened risk of harm and may not be suitable for all audiences. Content is restricted (18 years and older) and ineligible for the FYF if it shows or glamorizes gambling or gambling-like activities.</p></div><div class="sc-dNLxif hpqYSP"><div class="sc-jqCOkK 0px 0px 16px;">Released April 17, 2024</p><p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0px 0px 16px;">Effective May 17, 2024</p></div><div id="2024-H1-fyp-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><p>The For You feed (FYF) is a unique TikTok feature that uses a personalized recommendation system to allow you to discover a breadth of content, creators, and topics. In determining what gets recommended, the system takes into account factors including likes, shares, comments, searches, diversity of content, and popular videos. Learn more about the <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/transparency/recommendation-system/?lang=en" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">recommendation system</a>, as well as <a href="https://newsroom.tiktok.com/en-us/more-ways-for-our-community-to-enjoy-what-they-love" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">tools to help customize</a> recommendations.</p><p>Certain types of content may be fine if seen occasionally, but problematic if viewed in clusters. This includes content such as dieting, extreme fitness, sexual suggestiveness, sadness (such as statements of hopelessness, or sharing sad quotes), and overgeneralized mental health information (such as a quiz that claims to diagnose someone). This type of content may be eligible for the FYF but, we will interrupt repetitive content patterns to ensure it is not viewed too often. Learn more about our approach to <a href="https://newsroom.tiktok.com/en-us/an-update-on-our-work-to-safeguard-and-diversify-recommendations" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">safeguarding and diversifying</a> recommendations.</p><p>We maintain content eligibility standards for the FYF that prioritize safety and are informed by the diversity of our community and cultural practices. While the spontaneity of the FYF is what makes TikTok unique, it is intended for a range of audiences that includes everyone from teenagers to great grandparents. <strong>We make ineligible for the FYF, and may also make harder to find in search, certain content that may not be suitable for a broad audience.</strong></p><p>We know that the FYF provides an opportunity to reach a large audience, which is not always suitable for some young people. <strong>We make content created by anyone under 16 years old ineligible for the For You feed (FYF).</strong></p><p>Content that is ineligible for the FYF can still be discovered in other ways, such as through search tools or by following an account. When a video does not get many views, it may be due to a lack of community engagement rather than being ineligible for the FYF. Creators can use the <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/creators/creator-portal/en-us/tiktok-content-strategy/understanding-your-analytics/" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">TikTok analytics tool</a> to track the performance of their videos.</p><p>Throughout our guidelines, you will see eligibility standards for the FYF. Here is a consolidated "quick guide" of content that is ineligible for the FYF.</p></div><div id="2024-H1-fyp-text2" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><div class="sc-tilXH liITGI"><span class="sc-hEsumM cfiPAH href="/community-guidelines/en/mental-behavioral-health?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#2" style="white-space: normal;">Disordered Eating and Body Image</a></strong></p><ul><li>Showing, describing, style="text-align: left;">Using medication or supplements for weight loss or muscle gain, such as anabolic steroid use</li><li>Exercises designed for rapid and significant weight loss, such as cardio routines that promise to help you lose a waist size in a week</li></ul><li>Promoting weight loss or muscle gain products, such as sharing a before-and-after transformation</li><li>Promoting body types as ideal or perfect, when associated with potentially harmful weight management behaviors</li><li>Showing or promoting cosmetic surgery that does not include risk warnings, including before-and-after images, videos of surgical procedures, and messages discussing elective cosmetic surgery</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/mental-behavioral-health?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#3" style="white-space: normal;">Dangerous Activity and Challenges</a></strong></p><ul><li>Showing activity that involves visible or imminent moderate physical harm, or promoting activity that is likely to lead to moderate physical harm</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/sensitive-mature-themes?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#2" style="white-space: normal;">Nudity and Body Exposure</a></strong></p><ul><li>Showing semi-nudity of adults, intimate body parts (genitalia and nipples)</li><li>Showing infants and toddlers (under the age of 4) with implied nudity or partially exposing their buttocks</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/sensitive-mature-themes?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#3" style="white-space: normal;">Sexually Suggestive Content</a></strong></p><ul><li>Showing adults engaging in href="/community-guidelines/en/sensitive-mature-themes?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#4" style="white-space: normal;">Shocking and Graphic Content</a></strong></p><ul><li>Showing:</li><ul><li>Human or animal blood</li><li>Extreme physical fighting</li><li>Graphic or potentially distressing footage of events that are in the public interest to view, such as clashes with law enforcement or the aftermath of a bombing or natural disaster</li><li>Fictional graphic<em> </em>violence</li><li>Potentially distressing material that may cause anxiety or fear, such as showing non-severe injuries and accidents, dead animals, jump scare effects, or gory make-up</li><li>Mildly graphic material that may cause disgust, including human and animal bodily functions and fluids (such as urine or vomit), and close-ups of organs and certain animals (such as insects or rats)</li></ul></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/integrity-authenticity?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#1" style="white-space: normal;">Misinformation</a></strong></p><ul><li>Conspiracy theories that are unfounded and claim that certain events or situations are carried out by covert or powerful groups, such as "the government" or a "secret society"</li><li>Moderate harm health misinformation, such as an unproven recommendation for how to treat a minor illness</li><li>Repurposed media, such as showing a crowd at a music concert and suggesting it is a political protest</li><li>Misrepresenting authoritative sources, such as selectively referencing certain scientific data to support a conclusion that is counter to the findings of the study</li><li>Unverified claims related to an emergency or unfolding event</li><li>Potential high-harm misinformation while it is undergoing a fact-checking review</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/integrity-authenticity?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#2" style="white-space: normal;">Civic and Election Integrity</a></strong></p><ul><li>Unverified claims about an election, such as a premature claim that all ballots have been counted or tallied</li><li>Statements that significantly misrepresent authoritative civic information, such as a false claim about the text of a parliamentary bill</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/integrity-authenticity?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#4" style="white-space: normal;">Fake Engagement</a></strong></p><ul><li>Content that tricks or manipulates others as a way to increase gifts, or engagement metrics, such as "like-for-like" promises or other false incentives for engaging with content</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/integrity-authenticity?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#5" style="white-space: normal;">Unoriginal Content</a></strong></p><ul><li>Reproduced or unoriginal content that is imported or uploaded without any new or creative edits, such as content with someone else's visible watermark or superimposed logo</li><li>Low quality content, such as extremely short clips or exclusively-GIF based videos</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/regulated-commercial-activities/?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#1" style="white-space: gambling</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/regulated-commercial-activities?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#2" style="white-space: normal;">Alcohol, Tobacco, and hAbevy"><div class="sc-dUjcNx hFrQuN"><div class="sc-eerKOB dxAqel"><h2>Accounts and Features</h2><div class="wp-post-last-updated"><p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0px 0px 16px;">Released April 17, 2024</p><p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0px 0px 16px;">Effective May 17, 2024</p></div><h3 id="1">Accounts</h3><div id="2024-H1-features-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><p><strong>You must be 13 years and older to have an account.</strong> There are additional age limitations based on local law in some regions. In the United States, there is a separate <a href="https://newsroom.tiktok.com/en-us/tiktok-for-younger-users" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">under 13 TikTok experience</a>, which provides a more limited experience designed with additional safety protections and a dedicated <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/legal/childrens-privacy-policy" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">Privacy Policy</a>. If we learn someone is below the minimum age to have an account on TikTok, we will ban that account.</p><p>Violating our rules can lead to enforcement actions on accounts. <strong>We will ban accounts or account holders if they engage in:</strong></p><ul><li><strong>A single severe content violation</strong></li><li><strong>Repeated content violations</strong></li><li><strong>Circumventing enforcement of our guidelines</strong></li><li><strong>The operation of accounts dedicated to activity that violates our rules</strong></li></ul><p>This includes all activity that has a primary purpose that is not allowed on our platform, such as accounts focused on hate speech, the trade or marketing of prohibited goods, spam, or impersonation <em>(learn more about circumvention and dedicated accounts in <a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/integrity-authenticity/?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#6" style="white-space: normal;">Spam and Deceptive Behavior</a>)</em>. In the case of <a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/accounts-features?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#1" style="white-space: normal;">severe violations</a> of our rules or engagement in circumvention behavior, we may also ban any other existing accounts of the account holder on our platform.</p><p>We will also ban an account if we become aware that the account holder is a <a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/safety-civility?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#3" style="white-space: normal;">violent or hateful actor</a> or has committed a sexual offense against a young person. We consider off-platform activity related to violence, hate, and child sexual abuse or exploitation to help make decisions about these account bans. We report accounts to law enforcement authorities if there is a specific, credible, and imminent threat to human life or serious physical injury.</p><p>Repeatedly posting content that is allowed on our platform but ineligible for the FYF may lead to the account and its content being ineligible for recommendation, including being ineligible for the FYF and harder to find in search. Learn more about our general approach to <a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/safety-hc/account-and-user-safety/content-violations-and-bans" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">account enforcement</a>.</p><p><strong><u>News and Government, Politician, and Political Party Accounts</u></strong></p><p>News entities, governments, politicians, and political party accounts all play important roles in civic processes and civil society. While we treat their content just like any other account and remove violations, we approach account-level enforcement differently to align with our commitment to respecting human rights and <a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/community-principles?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update" style="white-space: normal;">free expression</a>. These public interest accounts will be banned for any single severe content violation, such as threatening violence. For repeated content violations that are less severe, they will be temporarily ineligible to appear in the FYF and in the feeds of their followers. In limited circumstances, they may also be temporarily restricted from posting new content. Learn more about our approach to <a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/safety-hc/account-and-user-safety/content-violations-and-bans" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">public interest accounts</a><a href="https://newsroom.tiktok.com/en-us/supporting-creators-with-an-updated-account-enforcement-system" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">.</a></p></div><div class="sc-dNLxif hpqYSP"><div class="sc-jqCOkK jIvPXx no-border"><div class="sc-uJMKN grexwc"><svg fill="currentColor" siteSlug="community-guidelines" class="sc-jnlKLf kcMArV" viewBox="0 0 48 48" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em"><path d="m24 28.75 13.67-13.67a1 1 0 0 1 1.41 0l1.84 1.84a1 1 0 0 1 0 1.41L24.71 34.54a1 1 0 0 1-1.42 0L7.1 18.34a1 1 0 0 1 0-1.42l1.83-1.84a1 1 0 0 1 1.41 0L24 28.75Z"></path></svg><div class="sc-bbmXgH BhRni"><p>More information</p></div></div><div class="sc-gGBfsJ hgbacM" style="height: 0px; padding-top: 0px;"><p><strong>News entities </strong>include organizations primarily dedicated to publishing news content to inform or educate. To qualify as a news account, the account must be legally licensed, certified or recognized by an intergovernmental organization, regulator, or reputable press organization.</p><p><strong>Governments and politicians</strong> include federal or national elected officials and candidates, state/provincial/territorial/local government entities, cabinet ministers, and official spokespeople. Learn more about who is considered a <a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/using-tiktok/growing-your-audience/government-politician-and-political-party-accounts" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">Government, Politician and Political Party account</a>.</p><p><strong><u>Severe violations</u></strong><u> include</u>:</p><ul><li>Promoting, inciting, or threatening violence</li><li>Showing or trading <a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/safety-civility?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#4" style="white-space: normal;">child sexual abuse material</a> (CSAM)</li><li>Engaging in youth sexual solicitation or grooming</li><li>Showing or promoting non-consensual sex acts, such as rape or molestation</li><li>Coordinating or facilitating human smuggling acts and services</li><li>Recruiting or coordinating human trafficking acts</li><li>Showing real-world torture</li></ul></div></div></div><hr class="sc-cIShpX bWEvDE"><h3 id="2">TikTok LIVE</h3><div id="2024-H1-features-subpost2-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><p><a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/live-gifts-wallet/tiktok-live" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">TikTok LIVE</a> allows you to create content, interact with audiences, and build your community in real-time. To support a safe experience on LIVE, we restrict young people from using this feature. <strong>You must be 18 years and older to go LIVE, and to send gifts to a creator during a LIVE session</strong>.</p><p>A violation of our rules will lead to closing an ongoing LIVE session, and may lead to temporary restrictions on using LIVE or <a href="https://livecenter.tiktok.com/rules_and_guidance/live_feature_guidelines?can_feedback=false&has_feedback=false&content_id=4&enter_from=rg_rules_handbook" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">LIVE features</a>, or an account ban. Accounts must meet <a href="https://livecenter.tiktok.com/rules_and_guidance/live_feature_guidelines?can_feedback=false&has_feedback=false&content_id=4&enter_from=rg_rules_handbook" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">relevant entry criteria</a> to be eligible for certain LIVE monetization features.</p><p>A LIVE is ineligible for the FYF when it shares content that is ineligible for the FYF, or when the main purpose of the LIVE is redirecting people to go off-platform. A LIVE is restricted (18 years and older) when it shares <a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/youth-safety?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update" style="white-space: normal;">content that is not suitable for young people</a>. If a LIVE repeatedly shares content that is ineligible for the FYF, we apply temporary restrictions on the account holder, including restricting the visibility of their LIVE sessions or their use of certain LIVE features.</p><p>In a <a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/live-gifts-wallet/tiktok-live/tiktok-live-multi-guest" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">multi-guest LIVE</a>, the host account is responsible for content streamed in their LIVE. Hosts must not facilitate a guests' sharing of content that violates our rules or does not meet our FYF standards. If guests stream violative content, it will lead to closing the multi-LIVE session, and may lead to temporary LIVE access restrictions for the host or guests. If guests stream content ineligible for the FYF, it will make the LIVE ineligible for the FYF.</p></div><div class="sc-dNLxif hpqYSP"><div class="sc-jqCOkK jIvPXx no-border"><div class="sc-uJMKN eBbeiN"><p>Using the search tool can be an enriching and helpful way to discover content on the platform. When you perform a search, we seek to provide you with relevant search results. <strong>We restrict searches that use keywords or phrases that violate our rules. </strong>Content that is allowed on the platform but does not meet our recommendation eligibility may not appear as a top search result.</p><p>We provide search suggestions that are relevant to you. These search suggestions can be found throughout the platform, including autocomplete in the search tool, content from the You May Like section, and while watching content in the FYF.</p></div><hr class="sc-cIShpX bWEvDE"><h3 id="4">External Links</h3><div id="2024-H1-features-subpost4-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><p>Links are often shared in a profile, bio, or content to connect you to additional content or to other sites. While some links may be helpful or informative, others connect to harmful content that would not be allowed on our platform. <strong>We do not allow posting links that direct people to content that violate our rules</strong>.<strong> </strong>A violation of our rules will lead to a removal of the link, a temporary restriction on re-uploading another link, or an account ban. If a link connects to content that would qualify as a <a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/accounts-features?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#1" style="white-space: normal;">severe violation</a> of our rules, we may also ban the account.</p></div><hr class="sc-cIShpX bWEvDE"><h3 id="5">Comments and Direct Messages</h3><div id="2024-H1-features-subpost5-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><p>Comments and direct messages on TikTok allow you to interact with videos or directly with others, and provide an integral interactive experience to the platform. <strong>You must be 16 years and older to use direct messages, and 18 years and older to use advanced messaging features, such as group messages in some regions.</strong></p><p>A violation of our rules will lead to restricted visibility or the removal of comments, or a restriction on sending direct messages, and may lead to an account ban if there is a <a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/accounts-features?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#1" style="white-space: normal;">severe violation</a>.</p></div><hr class="sc-cIShpX bWEvDE"><h3 id="6">Monetization</h3><div id="2024-H1-features-subpost6-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><p>We offer tools that let creators monetize their content, and that give businesses the ability to operate and expand their enterprise. <strong>You must be 18 years and older to use monetization features.</strong></p><p>Accounts must satisfy the relevant entry criteria to be eligible for our monetization features. Some monetization features, such as LIVE gifting, may have additional standards to use them. A violation of our rules may result in a temporary restriction of monetization features, and repeated violations will lead to a permanent restriction or an account ban. Content that is ineligible in the FYF may be restricted from monetization features.</p><p>All commercial content on TikTok must be disclosed and must comply with the relevant monetized feature policy, such as the <a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/business-and-creator/creator-and-business-accounts/branded-content-policy" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">Branded Content Policy</a>, <a href="https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article?aid=9552" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">TikTok’s Ads Creative Policy</a>, <a href="https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article?aid=9550" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">Industry Entry Policy</a>, and <a href="https://seller-uk.tiktok.com/university/policy?content_id=10003962&identity=1" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">TikTok Shop Policies</a>. If we become aware of marketing content that has not been clearly disclosed, we will apply the <a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/business-and-creator/creator-and-business-accounts/promoting-a-brand-product-or-service" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">content disclosure setting</a>. Commercial content includes promoting your own brand, products, or services, or exchanging something of value between creators, a third party and creator (such as Branded Content), a creator and business (such as e-commerce), or a creator and TikTok (such as the Creator fund).</p></div><div class="sc-kafWEX keKApY"><div class="sc-feJyhm lFBRW"><h3 class="H1-Bold" style="margin-bottom: 16px; hAbevy"><div class="sc-dUjcNx hFrQuN"><div class="sc-eerKOB dxAqel"><h2>Enforcement</h2><div class="wp-post-last-updated"><p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0px 0px 16px;">Released April 17, 2024</p><p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0px 0px 16px;">Effective May 17, 2024</p></div><h3 id="1">Public Interest Exceptions</h3><div id="2024-H1-enforcement-subpost1-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><p>We recognize that some content that would otherwise violate our rules may be in the public interest to view. Public interest refers to topics that inform, inspire, or educate the community and enhance deliberation about matters of broad collective significance. We may allow content to remain on TikTok under one of these public interest exceptions:</p><ul><li>Documentary</li><li>Educational</li><li>Medical and Scientific</li><li>Counterspeech</li><li>Satirical</li><li>Artistic</li></ul><p>Our approach to content moderation uses the same criteria, no matter who creates it. The most important factor we consider in looking at public interest exceptions is context, such as whether the content is raising awareness or criticizing harmful behaviors. To help us in our review, we encourage you to clearly show context using features such as captions, voice over, or stickers.</p><p>We may add extra safety measures to some content allowed under a public interest exception, such as making it ineligible for the FYF or adding a label, "opt-in" screen, or warning information. We do <u>not</u> provide exceptions for public interest content if it may cause extreme harm, such as showing a suicide or sexual abuse of a young person.</p></div><hr class="sc-cIShpX bWEvDE"><h3 id="2">Detection and Reporting</h3><div id="2024-H1-enforcement-subpost2-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><p>We aim to remove content or accounts that violate our rules before they are viewed or shared. Content first goes through an automated review process. If content is identified as a potential violation, it will be automatically removed, or flagged for additional review by our moderators. Additional review will occur if content gains popularity or has been reported. To support moderation accuracy, we apply additional quality assurance processes to some accounts that have already gone through additional validation processes, such as verified accounts.</p><p>Although we work hard to enforce our guidelines, we cannot guarantee that all content shared complies with our guidelines or <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/row/terms-of-service/en" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">Terms of Service</a>. Suspected violations can be <a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/safety-hc/report-a-problem" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">reported</a> in-app and on our website. If you discover content or accounts that may violate our rules, please let us know so we can review it and take any appropriate action.</p><p>Learn more about our enforcement efforts through our <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/transparency/?lang=en" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">Transparency Center</a>.</p></div><hr class="sc-cIShpX bWEvDE"><h3 id="3">Notice and Appeals</h3><div id="2024-H1-enforcement-subpost3-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><p>In keeping with our commitment to ensuring <a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/community-principles?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update" style="white-space: normal;">procedural fairness</a>, we seek to provide notifications if you have violated our rules. If you have posted content that we do not allow, we will notify you and share the reason for the removal. If your account has been banned because of a violation, you will receive a banner notification when you next open the app, informing you of this account change. If you have posted content that is ineligible for the For You feed (FYF), or is otherwise restricted, this information will appear in the <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/creators/creator-portal/en/tiktok-content-strategy/understanding-your-analytics/" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">TikTok analytics tool</a>.</p><p>If your account was banned, or your content was violated, made ineligible for the FYF, or otherwise restricted, and you believe it was an error, then you can <a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/safety-hc/account-and-user-safety/content-violations-and-bans#4" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">appeal the decision</a>. You can view the <a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/safety-hc/account-and-user-safety/content-violations-and-bans" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">status of your appeal</a> in the in-app Safety Center, as well as the status of any reports you have filed about other content or accounts.</p></div><div class="sc-kafWEX keKApY"><div class="sc-feJyhm lFBRW"><h3 dxAqel"><h2>Youth Safety and Well-Being</h2><div class="wp-post-last-updated"><p>Released April 17, 2024</p><p>Effective May 17, 2024</p></div><div id="2024-H1-youth-safety-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><p>We are deeply committed to TikTok being a safe and positive experience for people under the age of 18 (we refer to them as "youth" or "young people"). This starts by being old enough to use TikTok. <strong>You must be 13 years and older to have an account.</strong> There are additional age limitations based on local law in some regions.</p><p>In the United States, there is a separate <a href="https://newsroom.tiktok.com/en-us/tiktok-for-younger-users" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">under-13 TikTok experience</a> that offers additional safeguards, including restricting interactive features, content suitability assessments from <a href="https://www.sensical.tv/common-sense-networks/home" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">Common Sense Networks</a>, and a dedicated <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/legal/childrens-privacy-policy" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">Privacy Policy</a>. If you create a new account in the United States with a birthdate that shows you are under the age of 13, you will automatically enter into this experience.</p><p>If we learn someone is below the minimum age to have an account on TikTok, we will ban that account. If you believe you were incorrectly banned, you can <a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/safety-hc/account-and-user-safety/underage-appeals-on-tiktok" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">appeal</a> the decision. Anyone can report accounts that they suspect are under the minimum age, either <a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/safety-hc/report-a-problem/report-a-user" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">in-app</a> or <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/legal/report/privacy" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">online</a>.</p><p>We do not allow content that may put young people at risk of psychological, physical, or developmental harm. If we become aware an account holder has a <a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/accounts-features?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#1" style="white-space: normal;">severe violation</a> or has committed a sexual offense against a young person, we will ban the account, as well as any other accounts belonging to that person. We report incidents of youth sexual abuse and exploitation to the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (<a href="https://www.missingkids.org/HOME" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">NCMEC</a>). We also report to relevant law enforcement authorities when there is a specific, credible, and imminent threat to human life or serious physical injury.</p><p>To provide young people with an experience that is developmentally suitable and a safe space for self-exploration, we take several steps including:</p><ul><li>Setting minimum age requirements for access to <a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/account-and-privacy/account-privacy-settings/privacy-and-safety-settings-for-users-under-age-18" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">certain product features</a>, including being 16 years and older to have your content be eligible for the FYF</li><li>Using restrictive <a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/account-and-privacy/account-privacy-settings/privacy-and-safety-settings-for-users-under-age-18" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">default privacy settings</a></li><li>Developing content levels to restrict content that may not be suitable for people under the age of 18, and providing you with content filtering options</li></ul><p>You can learn more about TikTok's tools, controls, and educational content on our <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/safety/youth-portal?lang=en" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">Youth Portal</a> and in our <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/safety/guardians-guide/?lang=en" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">Guardian’s Guide</a>.</p><p>We allow a range of content on our platform, but some of it is only made available to adults. Here is a consolidated "quick guide" of content restricted from younger audiences.</p></div><div id="2024-H1-youth-safety-text2" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><div class="sc-tilXH liITGI"><span behaviors including:</li><ul><li>Restrictive low-calorie diets, such as extended intermittent fasting</li><li style="text-align: left;">Using medication or supplements for weight loss or muscle gain, such as anabolic steroid use</li><li>Exercises designed for rapid and significant weight loss, such as cardio routines that promise to help you lose a waist size in a week</li></ul><li>Promoting weight loss or muscle gain products, such as sharing a before-and-after transformation</li><li>Promoting body types as ideal or perfect, when associated with potentially harmful weight management behaviors</li><li>Showing or promoting cosmetic surgery that does not include risk warnings, including before-and-after images, videos of surgical procedures, and messages discussing elective cosmetic surgery</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/mental-behavioral-health?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#3" style="white-space: normal;">Dangerous Activity and activity that is likely to be imitated and may lead to any physical harm</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/sensitive-mature-themes?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#2" href="/community-guidelines/en/sensitive-mature-themes?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#4" style="white-space: normal;">Shocking and Graphic Content</a></strong></p><ul><li>Showing human or animal blood</li><li>Showing extreme physical fighting</li><li>Showing graphic or potentially distressing footage of events that are in the public interest to view, such as clashes with law enforcement or the aftermath of a bombing or natural disaster</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/regulated-commercial-activities?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#1" style="white-space: normal;">Gambling</a></strong></p><ul><li>Showing or glamorizing gambling or gambling-like activities, such as filming someone gambling or making any general positive statements about gambling</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/regulated-commercial-activities?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#2" style="white-space: normal;">Alcohol, Tobacco, and management </strong>means diets, medication, or exercise used for rapid or drastic weight loss or muscle gain that may create a long-term health or well-being risk.</p><p><strong>Moderate physical harm </strong>is harm that is unlikely to require professional medical treatment and does not pose a risk of disability or disfigurement. This includes small cuts with minimal blood loss and minor bruising on the body.</p><p><strong>Semi-nudity </strong>means being mostly unclothed and close to (but not actually) nude, such as implied nudity or wearing clothes that minimally cover intimate body parts.</p><p><strong>Intimate body parts </strong>means genitalia, buttocks, and breasts (including nipple and areola).</p><p><strong>Intimate kissing </strong>means kissing that may indicate sexual arousal or the beginning of a sexual interaction.</p><p><strong>Sexualized framing</strong> means content that intentionally emphasizes clothed intimate body parts through techniques, such as filming, editing, or positioning of the body in front of the camera.</p><p><strong>Sexualized behavior </strong>means behavior that is intended to be sexually arousing, including performances or repetitive body movements emphasizing intimate body parts, and imitating sexual acts.</p><p><strong>Sex product </strong>means an object or device that is designed to be used for sexual pleasure, such as a sex toy.</p><p><strong>Gambling</strong> is betting money (including digital currencies, such as bitcoin) or something of monetary value on an event with an uncertain outcome, for a financial gain.</p><p><strong>Gambling-like activities </strong>means activities that do not rise to the level of gambling, but are similar in behavior and carry similar risks, such as social casinos and gambling-related software.</p><p><strong>Tobacco products</strong> include vaping products, smokeless or combustible hAbevy"><div class="sc-dUjcNx hFrQuN"><div class="sc-eerKOB dxAqel"><h2>For You feed Eligibility Standards</h2><div class="wp-post-last-updated"><p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0px 0px 16px;">Released April 17, 2024</p><p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0px 0px 16px;">Effective May 17, 2024</p></div><div id="2024-H1-fyp-text1" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><p>The For You feed (FYF) is a unique TikTok feature that uses a personalized recommendation system to allow you to discover a breadth of content, creators, and topics. In determining what gets recommended, the system takes into account factors including likes, shares, comments, searches, diversity of content, and popular videos. Learn more about the <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/transparency/recommendation-system/?lang=en" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">recommendation system</a>, as well as <a href="https://newsroom.tiktok.com/en-us/more-ways-for-our-community-to-enjoy-what-they-love" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">tools to help customize</a> recommendations.</p><p>Certain types of content may be fine if seen occasionally, but problematic if viewed in clusters. This includes content such as dieting, extreme fitness, sexual suggestiveness, sadness (such as statements of hopelessness, or sharing sad quotes), and overgeneralized mental health information (such as a quiz that claims to diagnose someone). This type of content may be eligible for the FYF but, we will interrupt repetitive content patterns to ensure it is not viewed too often. Learn more about our approach to <a href="https://newsroom.tiktok.com/en-us/an-update-on-our-work-to-safeguard-and-diversify-recommendations" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">safeguarding and diversifying</a> recommendations.</p><p>We maintain content eligibility standards for the FYF that prioritize safety and are informed by the diversity of our community and cultural practices. While the spontaneity of the FYF is what makes TikTok unique, it is intended for a range of audiences that includes everyone from teenagers to great grandparents. <strong>We make ineligible for the FYF, and may also make harder to find in search, certain content that may not be suitable for a broad audience.</strong></p><p>We know that the FYF provides an opportunity to reach a large audience, which is not always suitable for some young people. <strong>We make content created by anyone under 16 years old ineligible for the For You feed (FYF).</strong></p><p>Content that is ineligible for the FYF can still be discovered in other ways, such as through search tools or by following an account. When a video does not get many views, it may be due to a lack of community engagement rather than being ineligible for the FYF. Creators can use the <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/creators/creator-portal/en-us/tiktok-content-strategy/understanding-your-analytics/" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="" style="white-space: normal;">TikTok analytics tool</a> to track the performance of their videos.</p><p>Throughout our guidelines, you will see eligibility standards for the FYF. Here is a consolidated "quick guide" of content that is ineligible for the FYF.</p></div><div id="2024-H1-fyp-text2" class="sc-fYxtnH eBbeiN"><div class="sc-tilXH liITGI"><span class="sc-hEsumM cfiPAH href="/community-guidelines/en/safety-civility?lang=en&cgverison=2024H1update#2" style="white-space: normal;">Hate Speech and Hateful Behavior</a></strong></p><ul><li>Some content that uses stereotypes, insinuation, or indirect statements that may implicitly demean protected groups</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/mental-behavioral-health?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#2" style="white-space: normal;">Disordered Eating and Body Image</a></strong></p><ul><li>Showing, describing, promoting, or offering or requesting coaching for potentially harmful weight management behaviors including:</li><ul><li>Restrictive low-calorie diets, such as extended intermittent fasting</li><li style="text-align: left;">Using medication or supplements for weight loss or muscle gain, such as anabolic steroid use</li><li>Exercises designed for rapid and significant weight loss, such as cardio routines that promise to help you lose a waist size in a week</li></ul><li>Promoting weight loss or muscle gain products, such as sharing a before-and-after transformation</li><li>Promoting body types as ideal or perfect, when associated with potentially harmful weight management behaviors</li><li>Showing or promoting cosmetic surgery that does not include risk warnings, including before-and-after images, videos of surgical procedures, and messages discussing elective cosmetic surgery</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/mental-behavioral-health?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#3" style="white-space: normal;">Dangerous Activity and Challenges</a></strong></p><ul><li>Showing activity that involves visible or imminent moderate physical harm, or promoting activity that is likely to lead to moderate physical harm</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/sensitive-mature-themes?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#2" style="white-space: normal;">Nudity and Body Exposure</a></strong></p><ul><li>Showing semi-nudity of adults, such as wearing only nipple covers or underwear that does not cover the majority of the buttocks</li><li>Showing youth in clothing that exposes substantial cleavage, or the clothed outline of certain intimate body parts (genitalia and nipples)</li><li>Showing infants and toddlers (under the age of 4) with implied nudity or partially exposing their buttocks</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/sensitive-mature-themes?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#3" style="white-space: normal;">Sexually Suggestive Content</a></strong></p><ul><li>Showing adults engaging in intimate kissing, sexualized framing, or sexualized behavior</li><li>Showing sex products</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/sensitive-mature-themes?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#4" style="white-space: normal;">Shocking and Graphic Content</a></strong></p><ul><li>Showing:</li><ul><li>Human or animal blood</li><li>Extreme physical fighting</li><li>Graphic or potentially distressing footage of events that are in the public interest to view, such as clashes with law enforcement or the aftermath of a bombing or natural disaster</li><li>Fictional graphic<em> </em>violence</li><li>Potentially distressing material that may cause anxiety or fear, such as showing non-severe injuries and accidents, dead animals, jump scare effects, or gory make-up</li><li>Mildly graphic material that may cause disgust, including human and animal bodily functions and fluids (such as urine or vomit), and close-ups of organs and certain animals (such as insects or rats)</li></ul></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/integrity-authenticity?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#1" style="white-space: normal;">Misinformation</a></strong></p><ul><li>Conspiracy theories that are unfounded and claim that certain events or situations are carried out by covert or powerful groups, such as "the government" or a "secret society"</li><li>Moderate harm health misinformation, such as an unproven recommendation for how to treat a minor illness</li><li>Repurposed media, such as showing a crowd at a music concert and suggesting it is a political protest</li><li>Misrepresenting authoritative sources, such as selectively referencing certain scientific data to support a conclusion that is counter to the findings of the study</li><li>Unverified claims related to an emergency or unfolding event</li><li>Potential high-harm misinformation while it is undergoing a fact-checking review</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/integrity-authenticity?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#2" style="white-space: normal;">Civic and Election Integrity</a></strong></p><ul><li>Unverified claims about an election, such as a premature claim that all ballots have been counted or tallied</li><li>Statements that significantly misrepresent authoritative civic information, such as a false claim about the text of a parliamentary bill</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/integrity-authenticity?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#4" style="white-space: normal;">Fake Engagement</a></strong></p><ul><li>Content that tricks or manipulates others as a way to increase gifts, or engagement metrics, such as "like-for-like" promises or other false incentives for engaging with content</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/integrity-authenticity?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#5" style="white-space: normal;">Unoriginal Content</a></strong></p><ul><li>Reproduced or unoriginal content that is imported or uploaded without any new or creative edits, such as content with someone else's visible watermark or superimposed logo</li><li>Low quality content, such as extremely short clips or exclusively-GIF based videos</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/regulated-commercial-activities/?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#1" style="white-space: normal;">Gambling</a></strong></p><ul><li>Showing or glamorizing gambling or gambling-like activities, such as filming someone gambling or making any general positive statements about gambling</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/regulated-commercial-activities?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#2" style="white-space: normal;">Alcohol, Tobacco, and Drugs</a></strong></p><ul><li>Discussing drugs or other regulated substances (as long as the substances are not being used or shown)</li><li>Promoting tobacco products</li><li>Showing the consumption of excessive amounts of alcohol by adults</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" href="/community-guidelines/en/regulated-commercial-activities?lang=en&cgversion=2024H1update#5" style="white-space: normal;">Commercial Disclosure and Paid Promotion</a></strong></p><ul><li>Marketing content that is not disclosed using the content disclosure setting</li></ul><p><strong><a title="" eBbeiN"><p>TikTok is a source of entertainment and enrichment where you can discover, create, and connect with others across the world. Our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy.</p><p>We have Community Guidelines to create a welcoming, safe, and entertaining experience. The guidelines apply to everyone and everything on our platform. They include <strong>rules </strong>for what is allowed on TikTok, as well as <strong>standards</strong> for what is eligible for the For You feed (FYF). To address new risks and harms, the guidelines are updated on an ongoing basis.</p><p>To help you read through the guidelines, we organize them by topic area, and highlight each rule in bold. Under each section you can click <strong><em>More information</em></strong> for definitions, examples, and clarifications to common questions. The examples do <u>not</u> cover everything (we are telling you this now so that you do not have to repeatedly read the phrase "including, but not limited to"). If you are ever in doubt about what to share, please remember to be kind and treat others the way that you would want to be treated.</p><p>Thank you for helping to keep TikTok a welcoming space for everyone!</p><p><strong><u>Content Moderation</u></strong></p><p>Keeping our platform safe, trustworthy, and vibrant requires balancing creative expression and preventing harm.             Last updated: February 2025
          </div> <div id="article_wrapper_slug_content" class="article_wrapper_slug_content"><div><div class="tt4b-rich-text-box"><h2 id="anchor-0-0" class="__anchor-header__">Principle</h2><p>At TikTok, users can share political content organically as long as it's in line with our <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/community-guidelines/en/" target="_blank" data-click_type="text_link" data-click_for="rich_text" data-url_type="link" data-click_text="Community Guidelines">Community Guidelines</a>. However, we do not allow political content to feature in advertising. We also do not allow content that disrespects religious elements, cultures, or figures, or any hateful behavior, hate speech, or the promotion of hateful ideologies.</p> <!----></div>  <!----><div class="tt4b-rich-text-box"><h2 id="anchor-1-0" class="__anchor-header__">Political content</h2><div class="tt4b-renderer"><div src="https://www.tiktok.com/@tiktokadpolicy/video/7408581292209605918?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc&web_id=7417856721002055211" class="block align-middle max-w-full tt4b-embedded-video tt4b-asset-renderer"><div><blockquote cite="https://www.tiktok.com/@tiktokadpolicy/video/7408581292209605918?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc&web_id=7417856721002055211" data-video-id="7408581292209605918" class="tiktok-embed" style="width:325px;border-radius:8px;" id="v13158922377221094"><iframe name="__tt_embed__v13158922377221094" sandbox="allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox allow-scripts allow-top-navigation allow-same-origin" src="https://www.tiktok.com/embed/v2/7408581292209605918?lang=en-US&referrer=https%3A%2F%2Fads.tiktok.com%2Fhelp%2Farticle%2Ftiktok-ads-policy-politics-religion-and-culture%2F" style="width: 100%; height: 739px; display: block; visibility: unset;"></iframe></blockquote><script async="" src="https://sf16-website-login.neutral.ttwstatic.com/obj/tiktok_web_login_static/tiktok/falcon/embed/embed_v1.0.11.js"></script></div></div></div><p><strong>Policy</strong></p><p>We do not allow ads featuring political content across any of our monetization features, including paid ads, creators being paid to make <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/global/bc-policy/en" target="_blank" data-click_type="text_link" data-click_for="rich_text" data-url_type="link" data-click_text="branded political content">branded political content</a>, and other promotional tools on the platform. We also impose prohibitions at the <a href="https://support.tiktok.com/en/using-tiktok/growing-your-audience/government-politician-and-political-party-accounts" target="_blank" data-click_type="text_link" data-click_for="rich_text" data-url_type="link" data-click_text="account">account</a> level for advertisers we identify as politicians and political parties, who are not able to create advertising accounts or access advertising features.</p><br><p><strong>The types of advertisers that are not allowed to advertise on our platform:</strong></p><ul><li><p>Candidates or nominees for public office, political parties, elected or appointed government officials</p></li><li><p>The spouses of candidates, elected, or appointed government officials with official duties or offices</p></li><li><p>Royal Family members with official government capacities</p></li></ul><p>Government entities may be eligible to advertise if managed by a TikTok Sales Representative.</p><br><p><strong>Examples of what is not allowed</strong>: </p><ul><li><p>Referencing, promoting, or opposing candidates or nominees for public office, political parties, or elected or appointed government officials</p></li><li><p>Advocacy for or against past, current, or proposed referenda, ballot measures, and legislative, judicial, or regulatory outcomes or processes. This includes ads that promote or attack government policies or track records.</p></li><li><p>Referencing, promoting, or selling merchandise that features prohibited individuals, entities, or content, including campaign slogans, symbols, or logos</p></li><li><p>References to an election, including voter registration, voter turnout, and appeals for votes, such as ads that encourage people to vote</p></li></ul><br> <!----></div>  <!----><div class="tt4b-rich-text-box"><h2 id="anchor-2-0" class="__anchor-header__">Culture and religion</h2><p><strong>Policy</strong></p><p>At TikTok, we do not allow content that disrespects religious elements, cultures, or figures. </p><br><p><strong>Examples of what is not allowed:</strong></p><ul><li><p>Sensitive religious content, such as disrespectful actions, words, or symbols towards a religion</p></li><li><p>Reference to religious figures or leaders in a negative manner</p></li><li><p>Claims that faith-based healing, counseling, or miracle-working can treat, cure, or alleviate physical, emotional, or mental health</p></li></ul><br> <!----></div>  <!----></div></div></div> <div class="help_center_feelgood_feedback
